# optimizelycmp_label_group (Resource)

A label group and its labels, written through the API's bulk settings import (experimental). The import only **adds** labels and never deletes anything, so: labels cannot be removed (the plan fails if you try), the name cannot change (a new name is a new group), and destroying this resource only stops Terraform managing the group. Use the group's display name. To manage a group created in the CMP interface, import it by that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmp_label_group" "pillar" {
  name             = "Content Pillar"
  has_single_value = false

  # Keyed by label name. Labels can be added and recoloured, never removed.
  labels = {
    Brand     = { color = "#4ECFD5" }
    Product   = { color = "#FFC700" }
    Community = { color = "#FF98A7" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `labels` (Attributes Map) Labels, keyed by label name. Adding a key adds the label; changing a colour overwrites it. Labels added in CMP outside Terraform are ignored. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `name` (String) Label group name. Changing it creates a new group and leaves the old one in CMP.

### Optional

- `has_single_value` (Boolean) true if only one label of the group can be chosen, false to allow several.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Label group ID.

<a id="nestedatt--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `labels`

Required:

- `color` (String) Label colour: one of #4ECFD5, #FFC700, #FF98A7, #5FEEAD, #D6C4F2, #5F9FF6, #CB5DEB, #9694B3 (upper-case). The API's documentation also lists #702BD5, but it rejects it.
